note: Village of Viola park on the Kickapoo River in the Driftless: one gravel loop of angled pull-in RV sites on open mown grass, the lower ones a short walk from the river bank. The horse arena and fair buildings are across WI-56/WI-131 from the camping loop. Hosts the annual Viola Horse and Colt Show. --Claude
summary: Village page, Travel Wisconsin, Campendium and imagery read. Confirmed first-come camping, showers, restrooms, dump; no rate or site count posted anywhere official (inclusion evidence's '$20' is not on the current village page). Waterfront lead not waterfront -> creekside. Horse arena is a separate area across the highway.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored not waterfront -> creekside (a Claude value, not --AWH). On zoom-19 imagery the lower pull-in pads at the south end of the loop (around 43.5050,-90.6715 to 43.5048,-90.6711) end ~13-25 m from the Kickapoo's north bank over open mown grass, no tree line between for most of them. The Kickapoo here is ~13-15 m wide, so the front value is creekside by the width rule. Site numbers are not published anywhere; all sites are first-come nightly. The stored evidence ('sites back from the wooded riverbank') does not match the imagery: the wooded bank is the far (south) side.

PRICE: no official rate is posted (village page lists none). Campendium shows a crowd-reported '$12' (undated). Stored inclusion_evidence cites '$20' and 'electric RV sites' from the village page; neither appears there now. Electric (30/50 A per Campendium) is not confirmed by an official source, so hookups stay unwritten. Campground season ('Open seasonally') has no dates.
HORSE RULE: passes. The horse arena, show barns and track sit north of the highway (around 43.5072,-90.6735), separate from the camping loop; nothing describes horse camping in the loop.
